h: Barcelona and Real Madrid reportedly eye Flamingos star Oluwakemi Adegbuyi
p: Barcelona and Real Madrid are reportedly interested in 16-year-old Flamingos forward Oluwakemi Adegbuyi after her performances in Nigeria's U-17 Women's World Cup win.
body: Spanish giants Barcelona and Real Madrid are reportedly interested in Nigerian teenager Oluwakemi Adegbuyi after her performances for the Flamingos at the FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup.

The 16-year-old forward played in all seven of Nigeria's matches in Morocco, scoring two goals and providing one assist as the Flamingos became the first African team to win the competition. Scouts from both clubs are said to see her as a candidate for an early move to European football, according to reports on Thursday, 12 November 2026. Neither club has commented.

Adegbuyi plays for FC Robo Queens in the Nigeria Women Football League and was named the league's Player of the Season for 2025/26 after scoring 11 goals. She was also named Player of the Tournament at the WAFU B Girls' Cup and at the WAFU B Champions League qualifiers, where she played for Edo Queens.

If a move to Barcelona happens, she would follow Super Falcons legend Asisat Oshoala. The Flamingos have been showered with rewards since their win, including ₦100 million savings certificates for each player from President Tinubu.
more: Adegbuyi scored twice at the U-17 World Cup.
She was Player of the Season in Nigeria's league.
